title: Machine learning identifies a low-tin lead-free relaxor composition window
summary: A multimodal literature-mining workflow and a physics-guided deep ensemble screened more than 150 million hypothetical compositions. The study reports that the x=0.01 and x=0.02 members of (Sr0.48Na0.26Bi0.26)(Ti1−xSnx)O3 met the authors’ predefined dielectric-stability targets while retaining room-temperature permittivity above 3300. The parent composition family and Sn substitution were already known; the result is a constrained low-Sn composition window, not a new parent chemistry. The reported upper-temperature stability criteria do not establish device certification or deployment.
ai_technology: Multimodal literature mining; deep neural-network ensemble
organization: Seoul National University; Korea University; Yeungnam University

source_review.scope: Primary PubMed record, article abstract, first-online date and affiliations.

evidence.tested: The authors report experimental validation of the x=0.01 and 0.02 Sn compositions against predefined dielectric-stability targets and room-temperature permittivity above 3300.
evidence.unknown: The parent family and substitution were known; the stated criteria do not establish full device certification or deployment. Direct publisher page was inaccessible, so evidence is limited to PubMed metadata and abstract in this check.
evidence.ai_role: Multimodal literature mining curated prior measurements and a deep neural-network ensemble screened candidate dielectric compositions and guided refinement.
